A significant form of a word, not being a verbal root (धातु), or an affix (प्रत्यय) is called a प्रातिपदिक or crude-form.

Terms: प्रातिपदिक

Before the word अर्थ the first member in the Dative -4th Case retains its accent.

Terms: समास accent

दुक् (द्) is optionally the augment of अन्य when अर्थ follows.

Terms: Some Substitution
